about.title: About Andromeda
about.intro: Andromeda is a blockchain publishing platform for literary works. Writers certify, number, and mint limited editions as NFTs; readers buy, read, and collect genuine copies. The platform connects authors and readers — it does not take a cut of your sales.
about.whatWeDoBody: Each work is stored off-chain on IPFS and certified on-chain on Polygon. Every copy is an ERC-721 token tied to its author's wallet. Ownership and transfer history are public and verifiable.
about.noFeesItem1: Andromeda does not charge authors subscription fees or listing fees.
about.noFeesItem2: Andromeda does not take a percentage of primary or secondary sales.
about.noFeesItem3Strong: 100% of primary-sale proceeds go to the author.
about.noFeesItem3Rest: The smart contract forwards payment directly to the author's wallet.
about.noFeesItem4: Authors remain solely responsible for taxes and legal obligations in their jurisdiction.
about.authorsPayIntroBefore: Putting a work on-chain involves costs that
about.authorsPayGasRest: — paid in MATIC when registering a work, minting copies, and updating on-chain settings. These fees go to the Polygon network validators, not to Andromeda.
about.authorsPayIpfsRest: — storing the text and metadata, typically via a pinning service the author chooses and pays for.
about.authorsPayBuyerRest: — when a reader purchases a copy, they pay network gas on top of the sale price. That cost is borne by the buyer, not the author.
about.authorsPayFootnote: Andromeda itself does not invoice authors for minting or publishing.
about.moneyGoesPrimaryBodyBefore: The reader pays the listed price in crypto. The smart contract mints the NFT and sends the
about.moneyGoesPrimaryBodyStrong: full amount to the author's wallet
about.moneyGoesSecondaryBody: Collectors may resell copies on external marketplaces. Proceeds and any marketplace fees are between buyer, seller, and that marketplace — not Andromeda.
about.authorControlEditionRest: — the author decides how many copies can be minted (e.g. 100 numbered editions).
about.authorControlCertRest: — each copy is author-certified on-chain and receives a distinct edition number.
about.authorControlSaleRest: — the author can enable or disable sales, or keep copies unsold.
about.authorControlPriceRest: — set a fixed price per copy, or list copies at auction to the highest bidder (auction support is on the publishing roadmap).
about.readersPara1Strong: digital copy of a book certified and signed by the author
about.readersPara1After: Each edition is tied to the author's public wallet address on the blockchain — the same idea as owning a physical book that is personally signed and authenticated by its writer, except in digital form and with a provenance anyone can verify.
about.readersPara2Before: When you buy a copy, the NFT is minted straight into
about.readersPara2Middle: It is yours — not a rental, not a subscription, and not an account locked inside Andromeda.
about.readersPara2StrongFree: Readers are not tied to this platform in any way.
about.readersPara3Before: You may read the work with Andromeda or with
about.readersPara3After: capable of supporting this kind of technology. The token stays in your wallet whether or not you ever visit Andromeda again.
about.donationsIntro: Andromeda is free to use for authors and readers. If you would like to support the project, you can make a voluntary crypto donation. Contributions help cover infrastructure costs — hosting, RPC, indexing, and related services that keep the platform running.
about.donationsQrAlt: QR code for crypto donations to Andromeda
about.donationsScan: Scan the QR code with your wallet app, or send crypto directly to:
about.donationsDisclaimer: Any EVM-compatible network or token your wallet supports may be used; verify the destination address before sending.
about.openBody: This page is public. You can learn about Andromeda without connecting a wallet — whether you are a reader, an author, or just browsing.
